resolved_seam_tensions.issue: S554D warns that authority versions must not create falsely independent supports.
resolved_seam_tensions.resolution: SCR554's STATIC_AUTHORITY_COMPLETENESS precedes duplicate counting. One invocation binds one exact rule id/version/hash; unresolved competing required snapshots hit K07 before support counting.

resolved_seam_tensions.issue: SCR554 names an admission-lineage fingerprint while HQ forbids provenance-only path differences from splitting support.
resolved_seam_tensions.resolution: SCR554 already limits duplicate-key differences to material components and says lineage distinctions remain distinct only when they can change interpretation/lawful use. M1 projects only materially governed lineage into the fingerprint; path/reissue/replay-only lineage is alias provenance. Unknown role => EQUIVALENCE_UNKNOWN.

resolved_seam_tensions.issue: SCR553 publishes compact producer refs while SCR554 demands richer consumer slots.
resolved_seam_tensions.resolution: SCR554 explicitly permits immutable dereference. SCR553 admission_ref/participants/source-universe/external-compatibility/authority-closure refs and exact hashes close the consumer slots without payload copying or label reconstruction.
